decisions.reason: The mill tour runs on existing heritage and event facilities at low marginal cost, and hospitality demand is recovering after the pandemic, so the option is still worth holding while that uncertainty resolves.
The sweet pastry fits the core range and costs little to sustain, and there is no negative evidence, so abandoning it now would give up cheap upside.

The farmhouse bread is close to the established assortment and cheap to produce alongside existing loaves, but since the similar hearty loaf was dropped earlier, its value is uncertain enough to watch closely rather than drop outright.
The gold-awarded poppy seed stollen is a flagship whose value has largely been confirmed, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
The premium stollen's gold award signals realized quality and seasonal demand at low incremental cost, so keeping it is clearly warranted.
